chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever washes a deceased believer and fulfils the trust in that act, Allah will forgive him."
It was said: "And how does he fulfil the trust in that?"
He said: "He does not disclose what he sees, and its limit extends until the deceased is buried."

key_terms.الْأَمَانَةَ: the trust or duty that must be faithfully upheld
key_terms.بِمَا يَرَاهُ: what he sees of the deceased
key_terms.غَسَّلَ: performed the ritual washing of the deceased

ai.seo_question: How does one fulfil the trust when washing a deceased believer in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that washing a deceased believer is not only a ritual duty but also a trust carrying moral responsibility. The trust is fulfilled by concealing anything seen of the deceased and maintaining that discretion until burial, and such faithfulness is a cause of divine forgiveness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever washes a deceased believer and fulfils the trust in that act, Allah (swt) will forgive them."
It was asked: "How does one fulfil the trust in this matter?"
Imam (as) replied: "By not disclosing what they see and maintaining their duty until the deceased is buried."
